sections.content: When sharing a meal, express what you want and offer items to others. Use 'kérek' for requests and simple statements for offers.

items.spanish: Kérek levest. A leves nagyon finom.
items.english: I request soup. The soup is very delicious.

items.spanish: Egy darab alma és egy pohár tea kérek.
items.english: I request one piece of apple and one glass of tea.
We have soup. (There is soup for us.)

sections.content: Possessive suffixes can be used to say 'our soup': 'a levesünk' (our soup). The adjective 'finom' can be emphasized with 'nagyon' (very).
